about: Lumbridge Swamp's surface, south of the castle, and the land just west of the castle: giant rats (giantrat, level 3, id 2856; giantrat1_2 and giantrat1_3, level 6, 2863 and 2864; the grey giantrat_grey to 3, level 3, 2859 to 2861), the rats west of the castle wall, the swamp's frogs (little_frog_nodrops, medium_frog_nodrops and giant_frog_nodrops, the Frog, Big frog and Giant frog of levels 5, 10 and 13, ids 8702, 8701 and 8700; the Wiki gives them their drops despite the names), the level 5 goblin (goblin_armed, 3045), the unicorn (2837) and a butterfly. Tiles and types are RSMod's rev 233 Lumbridge spawns, checked against the 241 map's floor (none is on water). Every wander range is guessed (5, the candle seller 2) until recorded. Giant rats are aggressive on live; NPC aggression comes with the Varrock piece, so until then they fight back only. With them, the swamp's talking NPCs: Father Urhney in his house, the adventurers' camp (warrior, archer, monk and wizard) and the candle seller by the caves. The fishing and mining tutors are the next step; the fishing spots are the gathering skills', and Hewey, Abigale and the two goblin sergeants, whom the cache shows by quest varbits, are left out for now.
